record.notes: Approved 19 May 2025 as Public Law 119-12 (S. 146); the Senate passed it on 13 Feb 2025 and the House on 28 Apr 2025. The criminal offences in section 2 have no delayed start date. Covered platforms had to establish the notice-and-removal process within one year of enactment, so the platform duties apply from 19 May 2026. A failure to reasonably comply with the notice-and-takedown obligations is treated as an unfair or deceptive act or practice under the Federal Trade Commission Act, and the FTC enforces the section also against non-profit organisations.
record.scope_note: Not an AI-specific law: it covers authentic intimate images as well as AI-generated digital forgeries. Included as the operative US federal instrument against publishing sexual deepfakes and for their removal by online platforms.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the GovInfo details page and the Public Law PDF (govinfo.gov, Government Publishing Office) stored on 11 Oct 2026; the archiver found both unchanged on 17 Oct 2026. judgment.status_reasoning: Approved 19 May 2025. Section 2 (the criminal offences) states no later effective date, so it applies from enactment. Section 3(a)(1)(A) gives covered platforms 'not later than 1 year after the date of enactment' to establish the notice-and-removal process: 19 May 2025 plus one year is 19 May 2026, which has passed. Nothing in the stored files shows an amendment or repeal. 'In force' stands as of 17 Oct 2026; date_last_updated stays null because no amendment is known, and the platform start date goes in notes as a partial commencement.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A federal law on nonconsensual intimate imagery that defines 'digital forgery' as a depiction created through software, machine learning, artificial intelligence or other technological means and applies its offences and takedown duty to such forgeries. Its offences also cover authentic images, so it is not AI-specific; under the rule for laws that are the operative instrument for deepfakes it is in with a scope_note, like AUS-02 and GB-08.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published and date_in_force are the approval date, 19 May 2025; the one-year platform deadline is a partial commencement and stays in notes.
